# Run book: Run a CGI program

[Run books](README.md) | [User guide](../user-guide/run-a-cgi-program.md) | [Spec](../specs/run-a-cgi-program.md)

- [Purpose](#purpose)

## Purpose

See a CGI program answer through the middleware, with its status, without a command line.

## Preconditions

- The example API is running and cgi-bin holds a program built for this system.

## Verify

Automatically: `npx playwright test e2e/journeys.spec.ts -g "Run a CGI program"` (add `E2E_BASE_URL=http://localhost:8088` to run against the compose stack).

By hand, in the example web application at `/developer/cgi`:

1. **Run the program.** The first program is selected. Get calls it with the name; the status and the page it returned are shown. Expect: The status is 200. The answer greets the name.

## Troubleshooting

**Table 1 — Known problems**

| Symptom | Likely cause | Fix |
| --- | --- | --- |
| The program list is empty | No program for this system is in cgi-bin | Run cgi-src/build.ps1 |
| 500 The program could not start | A binary for another system | Build the program for this system |

Related framework features: OoBDev.AspNetCore.Cgi; OoBDev.AspNetCore.Cgi.OpenApi.
